cycles.rationale: Prior score 0.9646 vs target 0.9714 (gap 0.0067). Key improvements: (1) Extended feature set - added u_i color index, magnitude skew, redshift cube/pos/neg, redshift x u_z and redshift x mag_mean interactions, g_over_z band ratio, 3 color curvature features, Lyman jump proxy, redshift x categorical interactions, Cartesian sky coords; (2) Upgraded to 4 diverse LightGBM models (varied num_leaves: 63/127/191/255, different seeds, slightly more trees: 2000-2500) plus XGBoost as additional diverse model; (3) Weighted soft-voting ensemble (LGBM weight=1.0, XGB weight=0.75) to reduce variance and improve generalization; (4) All models use n_jobs=-1 for parallelism; XGBoost uses tree_method=hist for fast CPU training. The ensemble diversity across model architectures and hyperparameters should push balanced accuracy above the 0.9714 target.

cycles.rationale:
Closing the gap from 0.9658 to >0.9714 with three targeted improvements:
1. NEW FEATURES: Added redshift regime binary indicators (is_low/med/high_redshift) which are highly discriminative for STAR vs QSO vs GALAXY separation. Added redshift_sqrt, additional redshift×color interactions (redshift_mag_std, redshift_u_r, redshift_g_i), cat_combo (ordinal encoding of spectral×galaxy combination), extra band ratio u_over_r, color_curve4, polynomial color terms (u_g_sq, g_r_sq, r_i_sq, u_g_gr, gr_ri, ri_iz), and SED shape proxies (blue_excess, red_excess, color_slope). Feature count increased from ~56 to ~74.
2. OOF THRESHOLD OPTIMIZATION: Added Nelder-Mead optimization of per-class decision thresholds in log-probability space, using 3-fold OOF on 80k sample. This directly optimizes balanced accuracy by adjusting class decision boundaries to compensate for class imbalance in the test distribution.
3. IMPROVED ENSEMBLE DIVERSITY: Changed from 4 LightGBM + 1 XGBoost to 5 LightGBM + 2 XGBoost with more varied configs: added extra_trees=True variant for one LGBM model (more random splits, good diversity), included deeper trees (num_leaves=511), added second XGBoost with max_depth=10. All models use n_jobs=-1 for full CPU parallelism.

cycles.rationale:
Improved v5 over prior best (0.9644): 
1. Full-data OOF stacking (5-fold, all training rows) instead of 150K sample, giving better calibrated thresholds 
2. Threshold optimization now uses average of 3 diverse base LightGBM OOF predictions for more robust calibration 
3. Added new features: mag_kurt, redshift_log_sq, r_over_z_sq, mag_mean_z, mag_std_z, color_curve5/6, i_z_sq, ug_ri, ug_iz, more redshift x band interactions, alpha/delta sin/cos, stellar locus proxies, SED curvature2, balmer_proxy, uband_excess, color_asymmetry, redshift regime extensions (is_neg, is_very_high_z, is_zero_z), spectral/galaxy neg-z interactions
4. Larger final ensemble: 8 LightGBM + 3 XGBoost (vs 6+2 before)
5. Blends direct ensemble with stacking base predictions for extra diversity
6. All models trained with class_weight='balanced' and sample_weight, n_jobs=-1
